answer: Deposits are visible in umber, and nebula reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 23 aliases, and each one needs its own funded harbor account. A bond of 35% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Scaling to 605 identities multiplies that fee by 341 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
